programs.title: Weirdest
programs.desc: Nat Geo Wild explores the beauty and ferocity of the animal kingdom, offering an intimate look at the world’s most incredible creatures in their habitats.

programs.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradis
programs.desc: An extreme weather phenomenon hits Katavi.Herds of hippos, lions and crocodiles living there must fight for survival and at the same time defend the territory against intruders.

programs.title: Predator Fails
programs.desc: Lions, panthers and other predators arouse admiration as reliable hunters.However, hunting down prey requires a lot of effort from them.Very often, their search for prey ends in failure, which means hunger.Viewers will see how the most famous hunters in the animal world cope.They will learn how strength, speed, strategy and teamwork make predators successful in chasing, fighting and killing.They will see the difference between ocean hunters and forest hunters and savannah kings.The creators of the series show how poisonous venom, sharp claws and huge mouths are used.They also present survival strategies for potential victims, who often manage to escape the predator.

programs.title: America The Beautiful: Wild South West
programs.desc: There is a 146-kilometer area between California's Death Valley and Mount Whitney, the highest peak in California.The authors of the program travel through deserts, mountains and wetlands with their camera.

programs.title: Saving Giraffes: The Long Journey Home
programs.desc: Eight giraffes are stranded on an island cut off by flooding.The only chance for rescue seems impossible: you have to quickly build an ark, convince the giraffes to get on board and transport them to the mainland.
